review: Only the two preregistered files changed. Native buttons retain default keyboard activation; aria-pressed/current communicate state, useId namespaces stable provider/model panel IDs. hidden keeps valid controls while excluding collapsed descendants from native interaction/accessibility. No custom tree roles or key handlers. Existing code/tests unchanged outside the additive semantics and mounted panel lifecycle. Independent DOM verifies scopes/IPC, current actual transcript, focus under real polling, multi-instance unique IDs and search removal/restoration. No business edits by reviewer. Tests use happy-dom, not screen-reader/manual keyboard simulation.
